title: Convert a ROS 2 .db3 bag to MCAP (and play Jazzy bags in Humble)
excerpt: ros2 bag convert with storage_id: mcap works once Humble has ros-humble-rosbag2-storage-mcap; delete the empty output folder a failed run leaves. Jazzy bags fail in Humble with yaml-cpp bad conversion until you play the .mcap with a QoS override.
